# Rally

> Rally is a shared place where a team and one AI work together. Spaces and Channels keep each project's files and history, Breakouts hold private side work, connectors read and write tools like Gmail, Google Drive, Slack, Notion, and GitHub, and Sidekicks run jobs on a schedule or when something happens. Pricing is per organization with no seat limit: Start is $100 a month, Grow is $250 a month. macOS beta. Made by Juno AI Labs Inc.

## Product

- [Rally home](https://rallywith.ai/): what Rally is, features, pricing, team, and technology
- [Support](https://rallywith.ai/support/): getting started and connector setup

## Compared to

Written by the Rally team, so biased, and dated on each page. Each page's Markdown source is published beside it at `index.md`, for example https://rallywith.ai/compare/slack/index.md.

- [All comparisons](https://rallywith.ai/compare/): one table of nine tools
- [Rally vs Claude Tag](https://rallywith.ai/compare/claude-tag/): Anthropic's Claude as a taggable teammate in Slack channels (beta)
- [Rally vs Grok Bot](https://rallywith.ai/compare/grok-bot/): An app for building named AI agents that run on a cloud computer
- [Rally vs Viktor](https://rallywith.ai/compare/viktor/): An AI employee you @mention in Slack or Microsoft Teams
- [Rally vs ChatGPT](https://rallywith.ai/compare/chatgpt/): OpenAI's AI assistant, used mostly as one person in one chat
- [Rally vs Claude Cowork](https://rallywith.ai/compare/claude-cowork/): Anthropic's agent that works through one person's files and apps
- [Rally vs Instinct](https://rallywith.ai/compare/instinct/): An invite-only personal AI agent you text or call for errands
- [Rally vs Notion AI](https://rallywith.ai/compare/notion-ai/): AI agents built into Notion's docs, wiki, and databases
- [Rally vs Slack](https://rallywith.ai/compare/slack/): Team chat with Slackbot, a personal AI agent, built in
- [Rally vs Microsoft Teams](https://rallywith.ai/compare/microsoft-teams/): Chat and meetings for Microsoft 365, with Copilot on top
